title: Power supply mount — almost there
stub: PSU is on the mount, AC protection is in — just need to dial in the twist lock.
content:
The power supply mount for the AI Dart Turret is nearly done. The PSU bolts to the bracket as intended, and AC protection is already in place.

No heroic cable routing on this pass — the remaining work is dialing in the twist lock so the supply seats and locks the way it should. After that, powered bench tests on the drivers.
